attribution_policy.rule: A measured acquisition placement gets one stable source_id and, only after separate authorization, one source-specific Telegram invite link. The generic public route may remain visible as an unmeasured social/profile link but must not be reused as the attribution mechanism for a measured experiment.

provider_rights_policy.rule: Do not grant the shared posting bot can_invite_users or broader admin rights merely to automate attribution. Invite-link creation is a separate provider mutation and a separate permission decision from publishing.

activation_prerequisites: one exact canary has been explicitly authorized, dispatched and provider-verified
the channel has a useful native archive rather than only outbound cross-post links
the source-specific placement has a real continuation value for the visitor
the exact source_id exists in this registry or is instantiated from an approved dynamic namespace
the measurement method is declared before activation

fixed_sources.purpose: Convert visitors already browsing real Milovi work into subscribers for future works, collections and useful guidance without interrupting the order path.
Measure low-friction site-wide social discovery separately from the gallery-contextual placement.
Measure voluntary VK-to-Telegram migration only where Telegram adds a collection, poll, detail set or other native continuation; VK remains a sales surface.
Measure Telegram joins attributable to Milovi video viewers without turning every video description into a redirect.
Measure whether low-cost Dzen distribution produces any incremental Telegram audience before assigning meaningful manual editorial effort.
Test retention acquisition from recipients who have already encountered the Milovi product; the QR proposition is future works and ideas, not a forced review or order step.
Measure opt-in subscriber acquisition from existing customers without spam, bulk DMs or making Telegram part of the required order flow.

dynamic_source_namespaces.rule: Instantiate one source only for a named, reviewed partner. Never use one generic partner link across unrelated partners.
Instantiate one source for one paid placement test and period. Preserve it after closure; never recycle it for another channel or later buy.
